newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Experience makes $8 mln writedown.
newsitem.headline: NZ Experience makes $8 mln writedown.

text.p: The New Zealand Experience said its NZ$8.92 million loss for the year to June 30 included a devaluation of $8 million for the Mount Cavendish gondola assets in Christchurch.
Final acquisition costs of the Rainbow's End leisure park in Auckland were $120,000.
The group operating deficit of $803,000 for the year compared to a deficit of $585,000 for the previous 9 month period.
Cashflow from operating activities was a loss of $201,000 compared to a loss of $85,000 for the previous period.
The group operating deficit of $803,000 was caused by:
* a 16 percent reduction in visitors to the Christchurch Gondola compared with the previous 12 month period.
* Rationalisation costs at the Christchurch Gondola compared with the previous administration costs, reflecting reduced visitor number expectations.
*Increased interest costs as a result of higher interest rates during the period under review.
* Below budgeted visitor numbers to Rainbow's End in the June 1996 quarter. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
